header_comment: %% metric_at(+C, +Metric, +Time, -Value) / Retrieves measurement at a specific time.
type_a_grounds: Point-in-time state access — directly indexes the measurement database by time parameter, implementing the fundamental state-at-T pattern.

header_comment: %% metric_delta(+C, +Metric, -T1, -T2, -Delta) / Finds the earliest and latest measurements and computes the change.
type_a_grounds: Compares earliest vs latest measurement across time — explicit before/after delta computation across two timestamps.

header_comment: %% metric_trend(+C, +Metric, -Trend) / Determines if a metric is increasing, decreasing, or stable.
type_a_grounds: Classifies the direction of change across time — derives trend (increasing/decreasing/stable) from the temporal delta, abstracting frame mutation into a categorical label.

header_comment: Computes rate of change of a metric across its measurement history.
type_a_grounds: Rate-of-change computation over temporal measurement series — quantifies how fast a constraint property is evolving.

header_comment: Computes second-order rate of change (acceleration) of a metric.
type_a_grounds: Second-order temporal derivative — measures whether drift itself is speeding up or slowing down, a higher-order frame-mutation tracker.

header_comment: Reports detected drift events with evidence tuples (metric_substitution, extraction_accumulation, coordination_loss, function_obsolescence, sunset_violation, extraction_dried_up, internalized_piton, coupling_drift, purity_drift, network_drift).
type_a_grounds: Fires when a temporal change pattern (mutation) is confirmed — the event fact itself is a record of a state transition detected across time.

header_comment: Context-indexed variant of drift_event/3 — detects drift relative to a specific observer context.
type_a_grounds: Context-indexed temporal mutation detection — adds the observer-position dimension to the drift-event temporal pattern.

header_comment: Detects when theater_score has risen while extractiveness remains high — metric substitution pattern.
type_a_grounds: Tests for a cross-metric temporal pattern where one dimension rises while another persists, indicating frame substitution over time.

header_comment: Detects when extractiveness has been increasing over time.
type_a_grounds: Directly checks temporal increase in extractiveness — pure Type A detector for accumulation drift.

header_comment: Detects when coordination effectiveness has declined while extraction persists.
type_a_grounds: Detects temporal decline in coordination — a state-mutation detector for the coordination dimension.

header_comment: Detects when a constraint's original coordination function has been superseded.
type_a_grounds: Tests for obsolescence by checking that alternatives exist and theater has risen — a lifecycle stage transition detector.

header_comment: Detects when a constraint has exceeded its sunset year.
type_a_grounds: Compares constraint's declared endpoint against current year — explicit temporal epoch comparison.

header_comment: Detects when extraction has dropped to near-zero while suppression remains.
type_a_grounds: Detects terminal-phase state mutation where the extractive mechanism collapses while enforcement persists.

header_comment: Detects when a constraint has calcified into a piton (internalized compliance).
type_a_grounds: Tests for the internalized-piton lifecycle terminal state — a stage-arrival detector.

header_comment: Detects when Boltzmann coupling measure has drifted from baseline.
type_a_grounds: Tracks temporal change in coupling structure — detects mutation of the coupling dimension.

header_comment: Detects when purity score has declined over time.
type_a_grounds: Tracks temporal degradation of purity — detects the mutation of structural integrity across time.

header_comment: %% constraint_history(+C, +Context, -Timeline) / PRIMARY API: Collects constraint history FROM A SPECIFIC CONTEXT. Same constraint may have different transformation patterns from different perspectives.
type_a_grounds: Builds a sorted timeline of state(T, Type) pairs from measurement timestamps — explicit temporal presheaf construction across all measurement points.

header_comment: %% constraint_history(+C, -Timeline) / BACKWARD COMPAT: Uses analytical context.
type_a_grounds: Backward-compatible variant that delegates to constraint_history/3 — same temporal timeline construction semantics.

header_comment: %% dr_type_at(+C, +Time, +Context, -Type) / Determines constraint type at specific time FROM SPECIFIC CONTEXT. DEPRECATED PATH: uses power_modifier/2 (direct multiplication).
type_a_grounds: Point-in-time classification — fetches measurements at specific Time T and classifies; the archetypal state-at-T predicate.

header_comment: %% transformation_detected(+C, +FromType, +ToType, -T1, -T2) / Detects when constraint transformed from one type to another. Uses actual measurement times.
type_a_grounds: Detects type transitions between two timestamps — explicit before/after frame-mutation detection with temporal evidence.

header_comment: %% transformation_type(+C, +From, +To, +T1, +T2, -Label) / Classifies the type of transformation with semantic label (capture, obsolescence, calcification, discovery).
type_a_grounds: Labels the semantic character of a detected frame mutation — builds on transformation_detected/5 to add causal/semantic classification to the temporal event.

header_comment: %% canonical_transformation(?C, ?From, ?To, -T1_earliest, -T2_latest, ?Label) / Returns canonical (deduplicated) transformation.
type_a_grounds: Deduplicates multiple detected transitions into a canonical record with earliest T1 and latest T2 — temporal range aggregation of frame-mutation evidence.

header_comment: %% predict_transformation(+C, +CurrentType, -LikelyFutureType) / Predicts likely future transformation based on trajectory. Uses least-squares slope on time-sorted measurements.
type_a_grounds: Forward projection of temporal trend — extrapolates from historical measurement series to predict future state, a lifecycle progression operation.

header_comment: Tests whether a sorted T-V pair list shows strictly non-decreasing values.
type_a_grounds: Validates monotonic temporal ordering of a measurement series — a trajectory-shape predicate over time-sorted data.

header_comment: Tests whether a sorted T-V pair list shows strictly non-increasing values.
type_a_grounds: Validates monotonic decline in a temporal measurement series — trajectory-shape predicate, symmetric to monotonic_increasing/1.

header_comment: Tests whether a constraint's metric trajectory is non-monotonic (reversal present).
type_a_grounds: Detects non-linear temporal trajectories — identifies constraints where the metric direction reverses, a higher-order temporal pattern.

header_comment: Defines valid one-step transitions between DR types with structural evidence.
type_a_grounds: Encodes directed lifecycle transitions (rope→tangled_rope, tangled_rope→snare, etc.) — the transition graph that frame mutations traverse.

header_comment: %% degradation_chain(+C, -Chain, -Evidence) / Detects multi-step degradation chains by examining measurement history.
type_a_grounds: Builds a deduplicated sequence of type states across all measurement timestamps, returning the full temporal type-evolution chain with T1/T2 evidence.

header_comment: %% DEPRECATED PATH: uses power_modifier/2. classify_snapshot(+C, +Time, -Type) / Classifies a constraint at a specific time using measurements available.
type_a_grounds: Point-in-time classification at a specified Time — parallel to dr_type_at/4, fetches measurements at Time T and classifies.

header_comment: %% predicted_terminal_state(+C, -State, -Confidence) / Predicts the likely terminal lifecycle state.
type_a_grounds: Predicts endpoint of lifecycle progression — forward temporal inference from current drift events to projected terminal stage.

header_comment: Retrieves a 4-component measurement vector [A, S, U, R] at a specific Time.
type_a_grounds: Fetches multiple measurement dimensions simultaneously at a specific Time T — point-in-time multi-metric state access.

header_comment: Computes weighted scalar coercion magnitude at a specific Time.
type_a_grounds: Computes aggregate coercive state at a specific Time T — aggregates time-indexed measurements into a scalar magnitude.

header_comment: Enumerates valid measurement time points within a named interval.
type_a_grounds: Generates valid time points within a temporal interval — the fundamental time-enumeration predicate that enables iteration over temporal states.

header_comment: Computes forward finite-difference gradient of coercion magnitude between T_now and the next available time point in the interval.
type_a_grounds: Forward finite-difference over consecutive time points — temporal derivative at T_now, explicit rate-of-change across adjacent measurements.

header_comment: Computes weighted aggregate system-level gradient across all levels at a given Time.
type_a_grounds: Aggregates per-level temporal gradients into a system-level rate of change at a specific Time — multi-level temporal derivative.

header_comment: Computes extractiveness gradient at time T by finding the next measurement and computing X2-X1.
type_a_grounds: Point-in-time forward derivative of extractiveness — fetches measurement at T and next-T, computes X2-X1, the canonical temporal gradient operation.

header_comment: %% infer_structural_coupling(+C1, +C2, -Strength) / Discovers hidden dependencies via temporal gradient correlation. Strength is sign-agreement ratio across all gradient pairs.
type_a_grounds: Correlates temporal gradient series across two constraints — requires iterating over all measurement timestamps to compare directional co-movement.

header_comment: %% analyze_interval(+IntervalID, -Gradient, -Completeness, -Pattern) / Pure return-value API. Computes interval analysis results without side effects.
type_a_grounds: Computes system gradient at T0 and classifies the interval as increasing/decreasing/stable coercion — interval-level temporal state classification.

header_comment: %% analyze_interval(+IntervalID) / Legacy API. Computes results and asserts them as dynamic facts.
type_a_grounds: Legacy wrapper that triggers temporal interval analysis and persists results as dynamic facts — same temporal semantics as analyze_interval/4.

header_comment: %% classify_interval(+IntervalID, -Pattern, -Confidence) / Classifies a temporal interval as structural_coercive_intent or a non-intent pattern.
type_a_grounds: High-level temporal interval classification — takes a named time interval and determines the overall pattern across its duration.

header_comment: %% network_drift_velocity(+C, +Context, -Velocity, -Contributors) / Velocity = sum of contributions (positive = degrading).
type_a_grounds: Aggregates temporal drift rates from neighboring constraints — network-level synthesis of per-constraint temporal velocities.

header_comment: %% cascade_prediction(+C, +Context, -Crossings) / Returns [crossing(ThresholdName, ThresholdValue, TimeYears), ...]. Predicts threshold crossings from current drift velocity.
type_a_grounds: Forward time-to-threshold prediction — divides current distance from each threshold by drift velocity to produce time-in-years to crossing.

header_comment: %% fingerprint_drift(+C, -Drift) / Returns drift(ExtractionTrend, SuppressionTrend, TheaterTrend).
type_a_grounds: Encodes the temporal dimension of a logical fingerprint as a triple of metric trends — packages three Type A trend computations into a single fingerprint component.

header_comment: %% metric_trend(+C, +MetricName, -Trend) / Determines categorical trend from temporal measurements. Returns rising/falling/stable/unknown.
type_a_grounds: Duplicate implementation of drift_events:metric_trend/3 — same temporal semantics, returns rising/falling/stable/unknown from measurement series.

header_comment: %% verify_interval_completeness(+IntervalID) / Checks for the presence of all 4 components across all 4 levels at T0 and Tn.
type_a_grounds: Validates temporal data coverage at interval endpoints T0 and Tn — structural check that the measurement database contains the required point-in-time entries.

header_comment: %% check_paired_measurements / Verifies that extractiveness and suppression_requirement measurements are paired at each time point for each constraint.
type_a_grounds: Validates co-temporal pairing of metric measurements — ensures the measurement database has synchronized time points across the two metrics required for classification.
